name: Ronde Van Brugge - Tour of Bruges ME

intermediate.name: 2nd passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 2nd passage of the finish line (143.7 km)

story: In a fast-paced race, repeated attacks failed to form a decisive breakaway. Strong echelons split and reduced the peloton but were eventually reeled back in. Jasper Philipsen launched his sprint slightly too early, allowing Dylan Groenewegen to come past and take the victory at the finish.
